The '''Neimoidian Inner Circle''' was a governing body of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and the [[Purse world/Legends|Purse worlds]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was likely to have been led by the [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]].

==History==
It had close ties with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], whose [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]], if a Neimoidian, served as a member of the Inner Circle. The Inner Circle was supposedly subordinate to the [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]].
